text:
marta: quick thought — our current canary auto-pause is too twitchy. small latency blips in the 1m window are stopping ramps. can we add a debounce + multi-metric decision so we don't pause on noise?

devon: +1. seen it twice this week. the controller pauses after a single 95th spike, then never recovers bc traffic drops and metrics get noisy. we need hysteresis. :grimacing:

ryan: curious about exact failure modes we want to guard: p99/p95 latency, error rate, token-cost burn? i'd propose a two-phase evaluator: immediate alerts for errors, but pause only after sustained violations across a sliding window.

selina: telemetry side — we should surface these as distinct series: canary_p95, canary_p99, canary_error_rate, tokens_per_req, cost_per_min. dashboard should show both raw windows (1m/5m/15m) and a summarized health state.

anil: also think about routing fallback. if token_cost exceeds threshold but latency is fine, prefer routing to a lower-cost quantized variant rather than pausing traffic outright. pause should be last-resort.

devon: implementation sketch: controller keeps two windows: short=1m, long=15m. require violation in both, or violation in short + a second consecutive short window, before triggering pause. that avoids single-burst pauses. default: p95>1200ms OR error_rate>1% OR tokens_per_req*rate > tenant_budget_rate triggers evaluation.

ryan: propose an API schema for guard policy. something like:
```
{
  "guardPolicy": {
    "windows": [60, 900],
    "conditions": [
      {"metric":"p95_latency_ms","op":">","value":1200,"consecutive":2},
      {"metric":"error_rate_pct","op":">","value":1,"window":900}
    ],
    "costAction": {"type":"route","target":"quantized:v1"},
    "finalAction": {"type":"pause","notice":"auto-safe: sustained latency"}
  }
}
```

selina: nice. can we also include a "dry_run" mode where controller sets a health flag but doesn't change traffic, so ops can tune thresholds from the dashboard first? and add an event stream for the UI to render "would have paused" vs "actually paused".

marta: UX requirement: Console rollouts page must show: current guard state, reason (e.g. "p95 over 1200ms x2"), last evaluation timestamps, and a one-click resume with audit comment. link to runbook and "suggested mitigations" (route to quantized, reduce traffic split).

deploy-bot: Canary 2026-03-18T10:34:21Z — autosafe evaluation: p95=1325ms, p95_window=1m violated, p95_window=15m OK, action=deferred (1/2).

devon: test plan: 1) unit test sliding window logic; 2) e2e with synthetic load that creates 1m blips and sustained 5m degradation; 3) integration test that verifies costAction routing happens without pause if latency not violated.

anil: edge-case: multi-tenant host with mixed weights — evaluator should normalize cost by tenant_weight and ensure global throttles don't accidentally hit tiny tenants.

selina: ops follow-up: i'll add panels for projected monthly burn if current token rate persists and expose tenant_weight on the rollout page.

ryan: two more follow-ups: (A) expose guardPolicy via internal API so infra teams can version it in infra-as-code, (B) all guard transitions emit audit events to the infra audit-log with reason and metric snapshots.

marta: action items: @devon own controller impl (PR by end of sprint), @selina update dashboards + add dry_run toggle, @ryan add API surface & audit events. i'll draft console copy for pause reasons. cheers. :coffee:

anil: SGTM.

marta: thanks everyone — will sync with product on default thresholds tomorrow.
